$comment: Session-describe reads the pinned upstream contract does not declare. The truth ratchet enforces manifest->code (a declared field's classification must be true); NOTHING enforced code->manifest, so a field we depend on but that the contract never declared was invisible — it simply arrived undefined and every guard built on it fell open in silence. That is how the pre-send context guard came to run permanently on its weak branch (live prod 2026-08-05: 200 consecutive decisions, fillSource always 'counter', while a turn died of context_length at a reported 51%). Enforced by describe-field-declaration.test.ts against the pinned version's derived session-event snapshot plus three explicitly enumerated agent fields (agentRuntime, thinkingLevels, thinkingDefault), whose presence in the vendored agents schema the test asserts: a CAPTURED direct-property read (`s.x`, `sess.x`, `o.x` inside the three swept source regions) whose field is neither in that reference set nor listed here fails the suite; reads through helpers, destructuring or bracket notation are not captured, as the test itself states. Listing one is a REVIEW EVENT, not a silencer — each entry must state what the code does when the field is absent, because that is the behaviour production actually gets.

estimatedPromptTokens.reason: Read at the TOP LEVEL of the session row, beside the nested read above, because the contract never said which shape the gateway uses and the two instructions in this repo disagree.
estimatedPromptTokens.whenAbsent: Nothing: the nested read is tried first and this only ever adds a second place to look. When both are absent the guard falls to the counter branch, as described for contextBudgetStatus.
estimatedPromptTokens.keepBecause: Looking in two places can only find more, never invent. Removing it before `/frame-discovery` settles the shape would be trading one guess for another.

promptBudgetBeforeReserve.reason: Same flat fallback as above — the denominator, i.e. the window minus the output reserve.
promptBudgetBeforeReserve.whenAbsent: The denominator falls back to the raw contextTokens. The two differ by the output reserve: the difference that makes a 96%-of-window session read comfortable while being at 117% of its real budget.

overflowTokens.reason: Same flat fallback — the gateway saying outright that the assembled prompt does not fit, the strongest signal the guard can act on.
overflowTokens.whenAbsent: The guard never sees a positive overflow, so its strongest escalation path is unreachable and it decides on the fill alone.

$resolved.contextBudgetStatus: Carried by the 2026.9.4 derived session-event snapshot — removed from this allowlist on 2026-09-12. It rode here since the pre-send guard existed because nothing pinned named it (2026.6.11 through 2026.9.2), so its shape had been instructed twice from observation and the two readings disagreed. NO CONTRACT DECLARES IT: no vendored TypeBox schema names it and upstream publishes no result schema for sessions.describe. The snapshot is a DERIVED artifact of the tagged implementation, which copies the field off the session row (session-event-payload.ts:120 at v2026.9.4); the describe carries it only because it answers with the same row builder (sessions-read-by-key.ts buildGatewaySessionRow via the session-utils.ts re-export, session-utils-row.ts:515), pinned by anchors and watched files in the bench's upstream-anchors.txt / upstream-watchlist.txt. The projection returns nothing unless a status is stored, the provider and model SELECTED to build the row (rowModelProvider/rowModel, session-utils-row.ts:515 — not necessarily the displayed, possibly canonicalised identity) are non-empty, contextTokens is finite and positive, the status names that same provider and model, a non-blank session id equal to the entry's and a budget equal to contextTokens, and no live model switch is pending (context-token-provenance.ts:125-151). Its absence removes all three nested inputs — estimate, prompt budget and overflow — each of which the flat fallback reads below may still supply (models-roster.ts selectBudgetAssessment); the fill then comes from an estimate, else the counter when usable, else unknown (core/context-budget.ts sessionFillDetail), and a positive overflow keeps its own path to compact_or_block (core/presend-guard.ts presendAction).
